mechanism_ledger.interpretation: Implicit argument realization may occur in individual FN cases, but omission of an overt argument is not supported as a systematic silence mechanism under the tested conditions.
mechanism_ledger.limitation: Not every possible implicit-argument construction is proven harmless; only the tested agent/theme/recipient configurations are negative.

mechanism_ledger.interpretation: No systematic theme-role silence effect under the tested conditions. No follow-up theme-role retest without independent reason.

standing_statement: 12 tested factors yield no reproduced systematic silence mechanism. Remaining signals sit at span/selection patterns and single lexical/verb-level findings.
